title: Time-Varying Pricing of Risk in Sovereign Bond Futures Returns
source_revision: Malinska, March2020, IES7/2020 working paper,47pages; published FRL47(2022),102531 is a different version
about: Realized moments and subsequent US/German sovereign-futures excess returns,2005–17.
findings: Author Table3: US10-year volatility coefficient−0.144, SE0.038, full-model R2 1.2%; daily higher moments insignificant in static regressions. Smoothed kurtosis effects change sign. Not our results.
mechanism: Time-varying risk pricing is proposed; no costed trading profit demonstrated.
build_on: Do not trade coefficient plots. Equation7 sums throughT; past-only estimation, macro availability and missing-value treatment need separate specification. Source uses interpolated control observations.
code_feasibility: Descriptive regression possible; a causal price-only adaptation would be a separate justified preregistered hypothesis, not the published strategy.
summary: DONT_TEST the smoothed-plot interpretation; no novel executable net edge established.
owned_input_map: ZN minute OHLCV exists2017–22. Source uses5-minute moments over05:20–16:00CT and term/default/yield controls. Native roll identity, controls/as-of clocks and16:00 versus Apex15:59 remain unadmitted.
reading_scope: Main methodological/result text and appendix captions; figures and all appendix tables not fully inspected. Full-paper reading not claimed.
